name: Exadata 诊断 — Exadata 特有的诊断与优化
description: Oracle Exadata 特有的诊断和优化规则。覆盖 Smart Scan（Cell Offloading）效率分析、Storage Index 利用率、Flash Cache 命中率、IORM 配置验证、Cell Server 健康检查等 Exadata 独有的性能维度。

conditions.desc: Exadata 环境需要专项诊断
Smart Scan 比例 < 50%（Exadata 优势未发挥）

root_causes.name: Smart Scan 未生效
root_causes.desc: 查询未走 Smart Scan（Cell Offloading），原因可能是：非全表扫描、表过小、使用了不支持的数据类型、或被 _serial_direct_read 参数阻止。

root_causes.name: Flash Cache 命中率低
root_causes.desc: Exadata Flash Cache 未有效缓存热点数据。可能是 cache 策略 (KEEP/NONE) 未正确设置或 cache 大小不足。

root_causes.name: Storage Index 未利用
root_causes.desc: Storage Index 是 Cell Server 上的 min/max 索引，可跳过不相关的 cell disk region。SI 未生效时 Smart Scan 仍需读取所有数据。

root_causes.name: Cell Server 异常
root_causes.desc: 个别 Cell Server 性能下降或离线，导致整体 I/O 不均衡。

root_causes.name: IORM 配置不当
root_causes.desc: I/O Resource Manager 未配置或配置不当，多数据库/多租户场景下 I/O 资源分配不公平。

step1_check_smart_scan.desc: 检查 Smart Scan 统计
step1_check_smart_scan.sql: SELECT name, value FROM v$sysstat WHERE name IN ('cell physical IO bytes eligible for predicate offload','cell physical IO interconnect bytes returned by smart scan','cell physical IO interconnect bytes','physical read total bytes') ORDER BY name

step2_check_flash_cache.desc: 检查 Flash Cache 命中率
step2_check_flash_cache.sql: SELECT name, value FROM v$sysstat WHERE name LIKE 'cell flash cache%' ORDER BY name

step3_check_storage_index.desc: 检查 Storage Index 效果
step3_check_storage_index.sql: SELECT name, value FROM v$sysstat WHERE name LIKE 'cell physical IO bytes saved by storage index%'

step4_check_cell_status.desc: 检查 Cell Server 状态
step4_check_cell_status.sql:
-- CellCLI: LIST CELL DETAIL
-- CellCLI: LIST CELLDISK WHERE STATUS != 'normal'
-- CellCLI: LIST ALERTHISTORY WHERE severity = 'critical'
SELECT 'Use CellCLI on storage servers' AS action FROM dual

step5_check_iorm.sql:
-- CellCLI: LIST IORMPLAN DETAIL
SELECT name, value FROM v$parameter WHERE name LIKE '%resource_manager%'

step6_cell_offloading_ratio.desc: 计算 Cell Offloading 效率
step6_cell_offloading_ratio.sql: SELECT ROUND((eligible.value - returned.value) / GREATEST(eligible.value, 1) * 100, 2) offloading_pct FROM v$sysstat eligible, v$sysstat returned WHERE eligible.name = 'cell physical IO bytes eligible for predicate offload' AND returned.name = 'cell physical IO interconnect bytes returned by smart scan'
